environment.server: one Uvicorn process, default asyncio on Windows, SQLite
environment.authentication: 100 real sessions for one synthetic administrator, login before timing
environment.measurement: request latency includes HTTP+authorization+DB; read-only business routes
environment.cpu_units: server process 100% equals one logical CPU; system CPU normalized over all CPUs
environment.isolation: new temporary SQLite and uploads; loopback only; no production data
environment.limitations: load generator and server share one workstation; not capacity certification
environment.resource_monitoring: Actual server interpreter sampled once per second; excludes venv launcher. Corrected harness now selects interpreter automatically.
environment.data_volume: 4 equipment records, 3 categories, 3 rooms; existing synthetic academic seed; no real user data
environment.runtime_baseline_evidence: Server loaded old Audit request failed handler before app/main.py error-redaction patch. git diff a3580b4 -- app/ shows only that handler/middleware change; auth/store/resource routes unchanged. No autoreload.
environment.post_fix_validation_scope: 24/24 post-fix integration tests are separate evidence; timed load was not repeated with new error middleware.
